description: This file defines a validation rule class `MyTimesheetActionRule` within the OrangeHRM Time module, used to validate timesheet actions against a predefined set of actions in `TimesheetService`.

classes.name: MyTimesheetActionRule
classes.description: A validation rule that checks if a given input action is valid according to the TIMESHEET_ACTION_MAP in TimesheetService.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input is included in the TIMESHEET_ACTION_MAP.
